I’m a Doctor With Stage 4 Cancer. Even I Struggled to Get My Insurance to Pay

Without insurance, emergency department or urgent care visits are completely unaffordable for the average person. In 2021, the Agency for Healthcare Research and Quality (AHRQ) estimated the average cost in the United States for a “treat and release” Emergency Department visit is $750. The bill could be much, much higher, even thousands of dollars, depending on tests performed and treatment administered. Even with insurance, affordability can be a major impediment …
